preconditions.description: The number of graph variants t must be between 1 and 100,000.
For each graph variant, the number of vertices n must be between 1 and 500,000, and the number of edges m must be between 0 and 500,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a_i <= n and 1 <= b_i <= n for a_i, b_i in edges)
preconditions.description: All edge indices a_i and b_i must be valid vertex indices within the range of 1 to n.

postconditions.description: The output must either be 'No' or start with 'Yes' followed by a line containing the indices of the stolen vertices.

postconditions.expression: len(stolen_vertices) == c and all(1 <= v <= n for v in stolen_vertices)
postconditions.description: The number of stolen vertices c must be valid and all indices must be within the range of 1 to n.

postconditions.expression: all((degree[v] - count[v]) % 3 == degree[v] % 3 for v in range(1, n + 1))
postconditions.description: After stealing the vertices, the degree of each remaining vertex must remain the same modulo 3.
